mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, thereby driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are not positively correlated with low unemployment rates over a 20-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% may signal tighter monetary policy, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, which could result in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases when the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment and high payroll employment suggests a strong labor market, which may lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are not positively correlated with low unemployment and high payroll employment over a 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP indicates economic expansion, which may lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative during periods of GDP growth in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests increased economic activity, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are not positively correlated with industrial production growth over a 20-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high consumer price index indicates inflation, which may lead to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases when the consumer price index exceeds 210.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high GDP and high real estate investment suggests strong economic demand, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are not positively correlated with high GDP and real estate investment over a 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate in a tightening monetary cycle may lead to decreased borrowing and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases during a monetary tightening cycle.
